Hard-coded fork context in harness.py lines 254-267 propagates through run_in_worker at lines 310-316, enabling unsafe closures/lambdas that fail under spawn due to unpickleable state
Process construction, pickling, and parent receive failures do not consistently fail open to RunResult abstain, allowing exceptions to propagate instead of gracefully degrading

Publicly re-exported run_in_worker requires explicit callable/serialization contract (importable names, pickleable args/kwargs/results) before switching to cross-platform spawn default
